items.headline: Texas RB Hollywood Smothers ruled out vs. Ole Miss
items.description: Texas will be without top tailback Hollywood Smothers for Saturday's showdown vs. No. 7 Ole Miss as the No. 19 Longhorns try to avoid a third straight loss.

items.headline: Texas AD Del Conte clarifies AI use on key play that failed in loss to Florida
items.description: Texas athletic director Chris Del Conte sought to clarify a report that the Longhorns used a new AI-driven platform on a crucial play that failed in last week's loss to Florida.

items.headline: Rowe takes us inside Texas minds, shares Chambliss' reaction
items.description: ESPN's Holly Rowe explores Arch Manning's perspective, Steve Sarkisian's take on his recent performances and shares Ole Miss QB Trinidad Chambliss' unexpected reaction.

items.headline: Tebow analyzes impact of star quarterbacks Manning and Chambliss
items.description: SEC Network's Tim Tebow joins The Paul Finebaum Show to discuss how Arch Manning and the Texas offense can get back on track and Trinidad Chambliss' ability to raise Ole Miss' ceiling.

items.headline: Fowler describes Manning's urgency ahead of Texas vs. Ole Miss
items.description: ESPN's Chris Fowler joins The Paul Finebaum Show to discuss Arch Manning's added sense of urgency as the No. 19 Longhorns prepare to face the No. 7 Rebels.

items.headline: Taylor Zarzour analyzes struggles for No. 19 Texas, No. 13 Alabama
items.description: With offensive problems plaguing both the Longhorns and the Crimson Tide, ESPN's Taylor Zarzour explains on SEC This Morning what each team must improve to avoid those issues.
